records.aiNotes: Extended alternating CH=CH chain is represented as a conjugated pi system. Neutral panel expressly has few mobile carriers, not zero carriers or guaranteed metallic conductivity. Oxidation removes electrons and gives positive carriers; reduction adds electrons and gives negative carriers. These are schematic electronic carrier models, not complete ionic formula/charge-balance drawings. Applied field in the right panel points right, battery plus is left and minus right, holes drift right, electrons left. The positive and negative drift arrows now agree with the same field. Interchain transport is represented separately. At360/316 the main few-carrier/doping/field/holes-right/electrons-left structure and colored charge signs are discernible. Secondary pi-system and oxidation/reduction explanatory text is small; the desktop680 rendering clarifies it. Essential opposite drift direction does not rely on those microcaptions.
